prime_directives.philosophy: Code is biological tissue. Ouroboros (Integrity), Digestive (Input), Nerve (Logs).
prime_directives.safety_protocol: NO LOCAL LLM (Ollama banned). Use Google API Key Rotation via Keyring class only.
prime_directives.legacy_constraint: PYTHON LEGACY ENV: Absolutely NO raw emojis in code strings. Use Unicode Escapes (e.g., \U0001F916) for all visuals.

async_db_interaction.description: Standard pattern for asynchronous SQLite operations with aiosqlite to prevent locking.
async_db_interaction.snippet:
async with aiosqlite.connect(self.db_path) as db:
    await db.execute('INSERT INTO table (col) VALUES (?)', (val,))
    await db.commit()

key_rotation.description: Mechanism to avoid API quotas. Never hardcode keys. Use the vault.
key_rotation.snippet:
key = self.keyring.get_next()
if not key: return 'NO_KEYS'
# make request...
if response.status == 403: self.keyring.bury(key)

error_handling.description: Silent fail-safe. Log errors to memory/syslog, do not crash the main loop.

http_requests.description: Robust HTTP client using aiohttp with timeouts to prevent hanging threads.
